Site.name: Konstantin Konyushkin
Site.description: Frontend developer with a love for history and heraldry. Homepage and project collection.

HomePage.greeting: Hello. I write interfaces by day and read chronicles by night.

about.title: About
about.text: Konstantin makes interfaces the way a scribe kept a chronicle, one careful line at a time, and with a weakness for the marginalia. React and TypeScript fill his working hours. History and heraldry fill the rest. This page is his armoury, and every piece in it was kept for a reason.

bio.title: Bio
bio.born: Born in Ulan-Ude (<ar>أولان أودي</ar>), the Russian Federation.
bio.university: Started studying information security at Moscow Power Engineering Institute (<ar>معهد موسكو للطاقة</ar>).
